title: Synthesis of fluorinated neonicotinoids
author: Andrii Kyrylchuk
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.9h5h386

steps.title: Prepare Reaction Mixture
steps.instruction: Combine the aniline, pyridine derivative, and base in a round-bottom flask.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve 2.0 mmol of corresponding substituted aniline in 5 mL of anhydrous acetonitrile.
Add 0.828 g (6.0 mmol) of anhydrous potassium carbonate.

steps.title: Heat and Reflux
steps.instruction: Heat the mixture under reflux until the reaction is complete.

substeps.instruction: Equip the flask with a water-cooled backflow condenser.
Heat the flask under vigorous stirring until the solution starts to boil.
Monitor reaction progress via thin layer chromatography (TLC).

steps.title: Filter and Wash
steps.instruction: Remove inorganic salts from the reaction mixture.

substeps.instruction: Rigorously wash the sediment with dichloromethane.

steps.title: Concentrate Solution
steps.instruction: Isolate the residue by removing solvents.

substeps.instruction: Remove the solvents by evaporation under reduced pressure.

steps.title: Purify Residue
steps.instruction: Purify the resulting residue using preparative TLC.

substeps.instruction: Perform preparative TLC on SiO2 using EtOAc/hexane (1:2) as the eluent.
